# Blender film from code: a 3D short written entirely in Python

**A brief becomes a Blender film built and rendered from one Python file: shots as data, stills first, critic loop, Eevee or Cycles.**

<p><img src="https://s3.varg.ai/files/4325c578-378d-4c43-ae53-3cc3218df1ea/file_417a3b4d8684.webp" alt="A low-poly forest valley at dusk rendered in Blender from Python: a glowing lantern orb drifts between pine trees through warm haze and floating sparks." width="480"></p>

Make a short 3D film in Blender written entirely in Python by an agent (Claude Fable 5.2, Claude Code, Codex): the shots and the look as data, a world built from code (procedural terrain, hundreds of instanced props, node materials, lights, haze), one camera per shot bound to timeline markers, a stills-first approval pass, a quarter-size draft, a contact-sheet audit, a fresh critic subagent, then the final render to PNG frames and an ffmpeg encode with an optional varg music bed. Includes a tested starter (scripts/film.py, a 9 s three-shot film) and the Blender 5.x traps that turn frames black. Use when someone asks for a Blender animation or film made with code or Python, "make a video in Blender with Claude", a 3D short, music video, toy commercial or product film rendered in Blender, a low-poly or storybook 3D film, or a remake of a viral Fable 5.2 Blender video. Not for previz that feeds Seedance (code-to-video-previz, varg-previz), three.js films in the browser (karpathy-3d-story, code-3d-explainer), recording a browser game (code-game-trailer), 2D motion graphics (hyperframes, kinetic-type-art) or AI-generated footage (varg-ai).

```bash
npx skills add vargHQ/skills --skill blender-code-film                # Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Grok, Gemini CLI, OpenCode…
gh skill install vargHQ/skills blender-code-film --agent github-copilot --scope user
# or all 78 skills as a Claude Code plugin:
claude plugin marketplace add vargHQ/skills
claude plugin install varg@varg
```

## Ask your agent

- "Make a 20-second low-poly storybook film in Blender with Python: a lantern drifting through a forest at dusk, 4 shots, stills first"
- "Make a 15-second 90s toy commercial in Blender for a glow-in-the-dark robot, then mux it with an upbeat jingle"
- "Remake this Fable 5.2 Blender film idea as our own: a desk room at golden hour turning to night, 6 shots"
